speaker: will_kemp
text: You have left me three lines and a door. I shall require a better door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have the door the play gives you. I am not carpentering a new one in the tiring-house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The afternoon is done. Tomorrow is the Shrew, and you are not in it, Will. Thursday is Titus, and the hired men will want their ten shillings.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I shall save the better door for a day when I am on the bill. Three lines is a short supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow I am at the desk. The Shrew is the company's afternoon. I am not in it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Be at the Theatre on Thursday morning, and do not spend Wednesday promising anyone a part.
